_comment: Behavioral rules agents must respect. Extend from Minecraft Wiki pack format notes; do not invent.

rules: atlases/ directory controls atlas sources
textures outside block/ and item/ need atlas coverage or may not render
GUI widgets/icons split into textures/gui/sprites/
supported_formats / overlays possible in pack.mcmeta
grass -> short_grass rename
map_icons split
scute -> turtle_scute (item id, models/item, textures/item) in 1.20.5 / format 32 — confirmed by Minecraft 1.20.5 notes + vanilla 1.20.2→1.21.1 asset diff
equipment models; armor textures move toward entity/equipment
item model overrides ignored; use assets/<ns>/items/*.json
custom_model_data must be expressed in new item definitions
saddles are equipment; pig/strider overlays move entity/<mob>/<mob>_saddle.png → entity/equipment/<mob>_saddle/saddle.png (25w03a)
textures/misc/enchanted_glint_entity.png → enchanted_glint_armor.png (item glint unchanged)
core shader uniforms moved into uniform blocks; packs shipping shaders need updates
block model rotations no longer limited to multiples of 22.5
leash sound renames; entity/leashknot/break sound added
panorama textures must all be the same size and square
oversized_in_gui item model field; player_head special model type
evidence: minecraft.wiki Pack format — resource pack format 63 (1.21.6)

rules: mostly additive textures/sounds/models — prefer rename-diff only; no known structural cliff for adventure packs
evidence: minecraft.wiki Pack format — resource pack format 64 (1.21.7 – 1.21.8): Added new textures

rules: pack_format becomes major.minor; pack.mcmeta may use min_format / max_format
block/item sprite chain → iron_chain
environment/end_flash.png + weather.end_flash; copper block/item assets additive
some post-processing vertex shaders merged (triangle vs quad); core/lightmap.fsh tweaks
evidence: minecraft.wiki Pack format — resource pack format 69.0 (1.21.9 – 1.21.10)

rules: items atlas split (snapshot format 73.0 / 25w45a): item/ (+ trim item overlays) move from atlases/blocks.json to atlases/items.json (no mipmaps)
all textures used in an item model must come from the same atlas (items or blocks); block models must use the blocks atlas
celestial textures under environment/celestial/ (CelestialSlicerUpdater1_21_11)
baby/entity texture layout: many entity textures moved into per-entity folders; baby variants added
lightmap / shader uniform renames (LightmapInfo: AmbientLightFactor removed into AmbientColor; DarkenWorldFactor → BossOverlayWorldDarkeningFactor)
item/entity shader split: core/item vs core/entity; some rendertype_* shaders removed/replaced
item model types gain transformation fields for sub-models

converter policy: strip pack shaders/core|post|include when converting from ≤1.21.11 → ≥26.1 — OpenGL-era GLSL cannot be reliably auto-ported to RenderPearl/SPIR-V/Vulkan; leaving overrides makes packs unloadable
evidence: minecraft.wiki Pack format — resource pack format 84.0 (26.1 – 26.1.2)

rules: beds use block models/textures; minecraft:beds atlas removed
signs/hanging signs move toward block models; minecraft:signs atlas removed (jar diff)
minecraft:end_cube model type for end patterns that break under old paths
text shaders consolidated to core/text (+ core/text_background); translucent moving block → core/block
evidence: knowledge/vanilla/26.1 has atlases/beds.json + atlases/signs.json; absent in knowledge/vanilla/26.2
knowledge/renames/26.1-26.2.json removed_sample includes atlases/beds.json, atlases/signs.json, textures/entity/signs/*
minecraft.wiki Pack format — resource pack format 88.0 (26.2)

rules: trim color palettes: textures/trims/color_palettes/ → textures/palettes/trim/; trim_palette.png → textures/palettes/trim_base.png
palette .mcmeta requires palette.base_palette; atlas palette_key/permutations resolve under textures/palettes/ (…/trim_palette → trim_base; …/X → trim/X)
override_armor_assets in trim materials → equipment trim_overrides (snap1 briefly used trim_palette_replacements; 26.3 jar/wiki final field is trim_overrides)
trim material asset_name → palette_id (datapack; combined packs)
armor_trims atlas removed; entity armor trim material textures generated on-demand (item trims still use paletted_permutations on items atlas)
evidence: minecraft.wiki Pack format 97.1 / Equipment history 26.3 snap6; wiki path text may say textures/trim/ — jar uses textures/trims/

adventure_hotspots.head_display_models: Often armor-stand mounted; verify pose after convert
